facts.fact: Updating (adding) a mobile number as a separate demographic update costs Rs 75
facts.quote: Update of enrolled name, gender, date of birth, address, mobile number or email address, or any combination of the same (i) If done at the same time with biometric update: Free (ii) If done separately: ₹75

facts.fact: A mobile number update is free when done at the same time as a biometric update
facts.quote: Update of enrolled name, gender, date of birth, address, mobile number or email address, or any combination of the same (i) If done at the same time with biometric update: Free (ii) If done separately: ₹75

facts.fact: The free Mandatory Biometric Update (MBU) for children is a stand-alone transaction and cannot be combined with any other update, so the free combination applies only with a paid biometric update
facts.quote: # Mandatory Biometric Update (MBU) shall be stand-alone transaction only; it may not be clubbed with any other transaction
facts.note: That the free combination therefore applies only with a paid biometric update is derived from this rule and the fee table.

facts.fact: Rs 200 for a mobile number update is more than the official Rs 75 (charges are inclusive of taxes)
facts.quote: Update of enrolled name, gender, date of birth, address, mobile number or email address, or any combination of the same (i) If done at the same time with biometric update: Free (ii) If done separately: ₹75
facts.note: Derived: the official separate demographic update fee is Rs 75; the ASK page adds 'These charges are inclusive of any applicable taxes.'

facts.fact: If a centre charges more than the prescribed fee, complain to UIDAI: call 1947, email help@uidai.gov.in with the centre details and URN, or file a complaint online
facts.quote: If the centre charged you more than the prescribed service charge mentioned above, you can file a complaint in following ways: • Call 1947 and register a complaint • Email the centre details along with your URN and contact details to help@uidai.gov.in
facts.note: UIDAI's Enrolment & Update FAQ gives the current online route: complaint on the myAadhaar portal https://myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in/grievance-feedback/en, helpline 1947 or help@uidai.gov.in.

summary: UIDAI Aadhaar Seva Kendra fee table: demographic (incl. mobile) update Rs 75 separately, free with a biometric update; MBU stand-alone; overcharging complaints via 1947 / help@uidai.gov.in / online (Aadhaar Handbook). All confirmed.
